pages.title: Operations dashboard
pages.description: Operations dashboard: revenue, orders, late delivery rate and review score for the period, the monthly revenue trend, open support tickets and products that need restocking.
pages.agent_context: Landing page. 'This'/'today' means the dashboard period (default last 12 months to 2018-08-31). The ticket and stock tables show live operational records, not the period. Typical next steps: open the late-orders page, resolve tickets, restock products.

pages.title: Orders
pages.description: Search customer orders by status, state, product category, purchase date, lateness and open tickets; see value, freight, days late and review score; open a support ticket.
pages.agent_context: 'This order' means the selected row or the order the user names (8-character ref like E481F51C). Orders are real Olist data; tickets are simulated. Typical next steps: filter late orders, open a ticket for an order, check the seller.

small_appliances_home_oven_and_coffee: small appliances home oven and coffee

pages.title: Late and overdue deliveries
pages.description: Orders delivered after the estimated date and orders still undelivered past it, with days late, customer state, review score and open tickets; open tickets for them.
pages.agent_context: Two tables: delivered-late and still-overdue. 'The late ones' means the delivered-late table unless the user says undelivered. Typical request: open tickets for every late order in a state (use the bulk ticket API), then check which sellers are responsible.

small_appliances_home_oven_and_coffee: small appliances home oven and coffee

pages.title: Support tickets
pages.description: Customer support tickets: filter by status, priority, category and state; resolve, assign or escalate them; open a new ticket for an order.
pages.agent_context: 'This ticket' means the selected row or a code like TCK-005631. All tickets are simulated records linked to real orders. Status flow: open -> in_progress -> resolved -> closed.

pages.title: Customer reviews
pages.description: Customer reviews with score and comment; find negative reviews without a reply and reply to them.
pages.agent_context: 'This review' means the selected row. Reviews are real Olist data (text is Portuguese); replies are simulated. Typical request: reply to unanswered 1-2 star reviews.

pages.title: Products and stock
pages.description: Listed products with price, cost, margin, stock level, units sold and days of cover; restock a product or change its price.
pages.agent_context: 'This product' means the selected row or a product ref like 1E9E8EF0. Sales are real; price, cost and stock are simulated. Price changes above +/-50% are refused.

small_appliances_home_oven_and_coffee: small appliances home oven and coffee

pages.title: Low-stock alerts
pages.description: Products that need restocking now, most urgent first, with suggested quantities, and how inventory value and low-stock counts moved month by month.
pages.agent_context: 'Low stock' means stock at or below the reorder point with nothing on order. 'Restock them' means place restock orders for the alert list (bulk restock API with from_alerts). Simulated data.

small_appliances_home_oven_and_coffee: small appliances home oven and coffee

pages.title: Restock orders
pages.description: Restock purchase orders and their status; mark them received (adds stock) or cancel them.
pages.agent_context: 'This order' on this page means a restock order (code RST-000123), not a customer order. Simulated.

pages.title: Sellers
pages.description: Seller performance ranking: revenue, late delivery rate, delivery days, review score and flags; flag a seller for poor performance.
pages.agent_context: 'This seller' means the selected row or a seller ref like 3442F895. Performance is real Olist data for the chosen period; flags are simulated.

pages.title: Seller flags
pages.description: Open and closed performance flags on sellers; resolve or dismiss them.
pages.agent_context: 'This flag' means the selected row or a code like FLG-00012. Flags are simulated, raised by rules over real seller performance (late rate above 20% or review score below 3.0).

pages.title: Seller acquisition funnel
pages.description: Where new sellers come from: leads, closed deals and conversion by marketing channel, the list of won sellers, and how much they sold after joining.
pages.agent_context: Real Olist marketing-funnel data (leads June 2017 - June 2018). 'Unknown' channel = missing origin in the source. Seller revenue counts from the day the deal was won.

pages.title: Sales vs target
pages.description: Actual revenue and orders against the monthly sales targets per state: which states missed or beat their targets and by how much.
pages.agent_context: Targets are SIMULATED plans (3-month run-rate plus 8% growth), not real company targets; actuals are real. Small states have noisy attainment; rank by variance for the biggest absolute misses.

pages.title: Delivery SLA
pages.description: How many deliveries were slower than the delivery SLA, by destination state, next to Olist's own late-delivery rate.
pages.agent_context: The SLA is SIMULATED (set at the 80th percentile of 2017 delivery times, one day tighter from 2018). 'Late' (Olist estimated date) and 'SLA breach' are different measures; say which one you use.

pages.title: Revenue forecast
pages.description: Revenue forecast versus actual revenue by month for the baseline, optimistic and conservative scenarios, and forecast error.
pages.agent_context: Forecasts are model estimates (linear trend on trailing 6 months), not sales. Jan-Aug 2018 are backtests that can be checked against actuals; Sep-Dec 2018 are future.

pages.title: Promotions
pages.description: Discount campaigns by category and state with status; create, change or cancel a promotion.
pages.agent_context: 'This promotion' means the selected row or a code like PRM-0013. Promotions are simulated and did not cause observed sales; the performance API compares sales before vs during.

datasets.description: Order lines (items) with customer and seller location, product category, price, freight and delivery outcome

fields.name: customer_unique_id
fields.description: Customer identifier (one per person; customer_id is one per order)

fields.name: freight_value
fields.description: Freight charged for the item in BRL

fields.name: is_valid_sale
fields.description: False for canceled or unavailable orders

fields.name: order_month
fields.description: Calendar month the order was placed

fields.name: customer_state
fields.description: Brazilian state of the customer (two-letter code)

fields.name: seller_state
fields.description: Brazilian state of the seller (two-letter code)

fields.name: delivery_days
fields.description: Days from purchase to delivery (delivered orders only)

fields.name: is_late
fields.description: 1 if delivered after the estimated date, 0 if on time, empty if not delivered

metrics.title: Revenue
metrics.description: Total item price of valid sales (excludes canceled and unavailable orders)

metrics.title: Freight
metrics.description: Total freight charged on valid sales

metrics.title: Items sold
metrics.description: Number of order lines in valid sales

metrics.title: Orders
metrics.description: Number of distinct orders with at least one item (valid sales)

metrics.title: Customers
metrics.description: Number of distinct customers (customer_unique_id) with a valid sale

metrics.title: Average order value
metrics.description: Revenue divided by the number of orders (valid sales)
metrics.sql: SUM(price) FILTER (WHERE is_valid_sale) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_valid_sale), 0)

metrics.title: Average delivery time
metrics.description: Average days from purchase to delivery for delivered items

metrics.title: Late delivery rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered items that arrived after the estimated date

datasets.description: Orders (one row per order) with status, customer location and delivery outcome

fields.name: is_valid_sale
fields.description: False for canceled or unavailable orders

fields.name: order_month
fields.description: Calendar month the order was placed

fields.name: is_late
fields.description: 1 if delivered late, 0 if on time

metrics.title: Order count
metrics.description: Number of orders of any status

metrics.title: Cancellation rate
metrics.description: Share of orders that were canceled
metrics.sql: AVG(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.title: Late order rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered orders that arrived late

datasets.description: Payments (one row per payment) with method, installments and customer location

fields.name: order_month
fields.description: Calendar month the order was placed

metrics.title: Average installments
metrics.description: Average number of installments per payment

datasets.description: Customer reviews (one row per review) with score and customer location

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Review identifier (not unique in the source)

fields.name: order_date
fields.description: Date the reviewed order was placed

fields.name: order_month
fields.description: Calendar month the reviewed order was placed
